question: How deep is the replacement, not merely that there is one?
not_a_point_value: depth_points is an ordering weight for printed slots. It is not a points estimate, a probability or a line adjustment, and it is not fitted to results.

depth.note: One official club page per club; every slot row carries its own club URL.

limitations: A printed chart is a club publication, not a confirmed starting lineup.
Only Week 10 has a captured chart; earlier weeks have no printed depth to measure.
Nine clubs publish no game status, so 'out' and 'questionable' are not separated everywhere.
Position labels on the report and on the chart differ; the mapping is published separately.
